files.title: File:MokoShuraiE-Kotoba I.jpg
files.description: Painting scrolls on the Mongol invasions (Japanese: Mooko shuurai e-kotoba), by Fukuda Taika, 1846 (copy of a 1293 work by an unknown artist). Ink and water colors on paper. Height 47 cm, length of the whole scrolls is 12.12 m (scroll 2) and 11.96 m (scroll 4). Tokyo National Museum, Inv. no. A-1637. The scrolls deal with the deeds of Takezaki Suenaga, who lived in southern Higo (now Matsubase municipality, Kumamoto prefecture) during the Mongol invasions of 1274 and 1281.
files.credit: Dschingis Khan und seine Erben (exhibition catalogue), München 2005, p. 334
files.artist: Fukuda Taika / (of the reproduction) Tokyo National Museum
